body.x: Navsys Technology Inc. (co-CEOs Sungjin Kim and Don Kim) announced its participation in CES 2025, which will occur at the K-Startup Pavilion in Las Vegas, USA, from January 7 to 10.

Navsys specializes in advanced satellite navigation systems (GNSS) technology, offering exceptional precision and reliability solutions. These technologies cater to sectors requiring high accuracy, such as public infrastructure monitoring, natural disaster management, and autonomous driving.

The company's flagship technology, RTK-OMEGA, is a key driver of its differentiation. At CES 2025, Navsys plans to present this technology alongside its supporting hardware and software to explore new market opportunities.

The mmTR Receiver, powered by Navsys, delivers millimeter-level precision in location data. This accuracy is invaluable for applications in infrastructure monitoring, disaster management, and autonomous systems where high-precision data is crucial. Additionally, the Lane-detector application, enabled by RTK-OMEGA, provides real-time lane detection for vehicles, enhancing the safety of autonomous and connected cars while also improving existing navigation systems.

body.cap: Navsys’s mmTR Receiver | Photo provided by Navsys Technology

body.x: Navsys emphasizes the adaptability of its solutions through integration with advanced GNSS technologies. This adaptability enables the company to serve emerging industries reliant on precise location data, paving the way for broader market penetration and technological collaboration.

A Navsys representative highlighted the company’s strategic expansion into Indonesia, the world’s fourth-most populous nation. In 2024, Navsys secured multiple memorandums of understanding (MOUs) and non-disclosure agreements with local engineering firms, obtaining government approval for its localization efforts. The company expects to address Indonesia’s public infrastructure and disaster management needs in 2025, marking its first significant export milestone.

The representative added that CES 2025 offers a critical opportunity to explore smart city and infrastructure opportunities in North America while engaging with decision-makers from Southeast Asian institutions and corporations. Navsys aims to establish a global presence through aggressive marketing, early-stage reference projects, and strategic localization efforts, advancing its vision to become a globally recognized leader in precision GNSS solutions.

body.x: AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
